what_follows.question: Months on, Halima is far from any boat. Going only by the passage, which of these would most likely bring the ferry to her again?
what_follows.right: damp rope drying on a rail
wrong: a key hung on a nail

what_follows.question: Suppose the door had let in no smell at all that morning. Going only by the passage, which of these would most likely not have happened?
what_follows.right: picturing the bench by the hatch
wrong: hanging the key on its nail

plain_fact.question: What hung on the nail afterwards?
